AgentStep.description: One model response and its local tool activity, without raw content.

ArtifactRef.title: ArtifactRef
ArtifactRef.description: Stable reference passed between nodes instead of a mutable Artifact.

message.title: Message
message.default: 运行状态或范围外引用阻止清理，请查看 blockers

ContentFingerprint.title: ContentFingerprint
ContentFingerprint.description: Opaque content identity; ``from_value`` supplies deterministic hashing.

FailureCategory.title: FailureCategory
FailureCategory.description: 负责分类某类失败的系统边界。

FailureInfo.title: FailureInfo
FailureInfo.description: 供 Runtime 选择恢复动作的、与 Provider 无关的失败信息。

FollowUpDecision.title: FollowUpDecision
FollowUpDecision.description:
Route request returned by the segment summary node.

The two flags only request the fixed follow-up nodes.  They do not state
that a relationship or state fact has already changed.

GraphSourceRef.title: GraphSourceRef
GraphSourceRef.description: One immutable source identity included in a graph input boundary.

target.description: 输入提供的实际认识对象；背景人物只写自然称呼。

Page_Annotated_Union_SegmentSummary__Dig.title: Page[Annotated[Union[SegmentSummary, DigestSummary, FactSummary, CognitionSummary], FieldInfo(annotation=NoneType, required=True, discriminator='record_kind')]]

RecoveryAction.title: RecoveryAction
RecoveryAction.description: 失败的 Agent 操作下一步要执行的动作。

ReflectionGraphRun.title: ReflectionGraphRun
ReflectionGraphRun.description: Identity and aggregate lifecycle of one graph execution.

ReflectionLease.title: ReflectionLease
ReflectionLease.description: Fencing identity attached to one claimed node task.

ReflectionNodeTask.title: ReflectionNodeTask
ReflectionNodeTask.description:
Scheduling and lease state for one fixed graph node.

The task stores only the node input fingerprint and predecessor Artifact
references. Node output is immutable and lives in ReflectionArtifact.

ReflectionSourceScope.title: ReflectionSourceScope
ReflectionSourceScope.description: The frozen source boundary shared by all nodes of one graph run.

dimension.title: Dimension
dimension.description: 关系维度，只能是 affection、trust 或 attachment。

direction.title: Direction
direction.description: 本次来源显示的关系变化方向。

level.title: Level
level.description: 本次关系变化幅度；positive 或 negative 为 1 到 3，neutral 为 0。

RelationshipDimensionAction.title: RelationshipDimensionAction
RelationshipDimensionAction.description: One typed relationship dimension suggested by a node.

dimensions.title: Dimensions
dimensions.description: 本次来源显示发生变化的关系维度列表。

TaskRecoveryDecision.title: TaskRecoveryDecision
TaskRecoveryDecision.description: Runtime 对一次 Agent 任务尝试结果作出的恢复决定。

ToolActivity.title: ToolActivity
ToolActivity.description: Safe summary of one local tool activity within an Agent Step.

UsageSummary.title: UsageSummary
UsageSummary.description: Bounded model and tool usage counters; no prompt or output content.

echo_commons__modules__reflection__domai.title: OutputContractRef
echo_commons__modules__reflection__domai.description: Domain-side reference to one node output contract.
